rationale: The previous candidate improved stability by reducing kd to 2.5 and increasing ki to 0.7, and lowering base_speed to 1.3. However, the slalom track still had a 0% finish rate due to stalling, and line loss events remain high on the oval track. To address persistent stalling on the slalom track, I will further reduce base_speed from 1.3 to 1.1 to improve stability and prevent stalls. I will also increase ki from 0.7 to 1.0 to enhance steady-state error correction, aiming to reduce rms_error and line loss events. Since steering oscillation remains moderately high, I will reduce kd from 2.5 to 2.0 to further smooth steering and reduce overcorrection. The geometry and sensor layout remain unchanged as they have supported stable line tracking. The line loss strategy remains 'last_direction' as it has helped reduce stalls previously. I continue to request the same measurements to monitor completion, progress, errors, line loss, and steering oscillation. I expect these changes to improve finish rates on the slalom track by reducing stalls, lower rms_error and line loss events, and reduce steering oscillation for smoother control.
